overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation on either allegation: the June 20 executive session discussed no substantive topic, and the minutes notice topic needed no specific meeting date.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Board held an illegal executive session by citing G.L. c. 59, §60 instead of Open Meeting Law purposes to discuss negotiation strategy.
Complaint alleged the notice topic 'Review and Approval of Minutes from previous board meeting' was insufficient because it did not state the meeting date of the minutes.
allegations.key_passage: identifying meeting minutes to be reviewed as minutes of the prior meeting rather than by specific date is sufficient.
